info.title: Needless
info.synopsis: In una Tokyo devastata dalla Terza Guerra Mondiale si è formato il cosidetto Black Spot, un'area oscura contaminata dalle radiazioni, che il governo ha subito isolato dal resto della città. In quest'area vivono mutanti che la gente chiama con l’appellativo di Needless, “gli Inutili”. In un mondo ormai devastato e privo di normali regole sociali, cammina un uomo vestito da prete, intenzionato a riprendere le redini della situazione.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Whilst out shopping Eve and Cruz are attacked by one of Simeon's most dangerous Needless. At first the battle seems hopeless but Eve is far more powerful than she looks and once she learns the secret of her opponent’s seemingly endless abilities she quickly turns the tide of the battle.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Adam is attacked by a Needless called Teruyama Momiji who is seeking revenge for the murder of his friends and family. After a heated battle it emerges that Momiji has the wrong Adam, in fact the man he wants is Adam Arclight. As such he quickly joins forces with the group from the church.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Adam and the others receive information from a mysterious character called Disk who instructs them to head to Iron Mountain. When they finally meet Disk they are surprised to find a young female cyborg rather than the decrepit old man they expected.
